subject: Service account retirement + SCIM reconciliation playbook (SOC2 evidence)
messages:
From: Rebecca Chen <rebecca.chen@medisure.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: audit@sigassessments.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: service account retirement evidence + SCIM delta samples (SOC2)

Hi Markus,

As part of MediSure's SOC2 Type II review, the auditor has flagged a set of service accounts and asked for: 1) a list of service accounts that were retired in the last 12 months with justification; 2) SCIM delta samples showing provisioning/deprovisioning events for those identities; and 3) our RBAC mapping evidence showing how those accounts were scoped.

Can Redwood provide: a CSV export of retired service accounts, the SCIM delta (sample batches) covering the retirements, and a short workback/playbook that shows who approved retirements and what logs we can pull for audit? Auditor deadline is 2026-08-20 (soft) but they'd like an initial handoff by 08/12.

Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Rebecca Chen
Director, Compliance
MediSure Health

--
Attachment: sample_request_template.docx (docx)

From: markus.klein@redwood.com
To: Rebecca Chen <rebecca.chen@medisure.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, audit@sigassessments.com
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: service account retirement evidence + SCIM delta samples (SOC2)

Rebecca — thanks for the clear ask. We'll deliver an initial package by 2026-08-12 and the full evidence set by 08/18. Proposed short-scope workback below: 

1) Export: service-account-inventory.csv (owner, created_at, last_used, retirement_date, retirement_reason, approval_ticket) — PRACTICAL OWNER: Priyom
2) SCIM delta samples: three delta windows (retirement event, 24h audit trace, 7d reconcile) — PRACTICAL OWNER: Priyom
3) RBAC mapping: one-page mapping explaining how cloud roles map to Redwood RBAC and list of least-privilege checks used — PRACTICAL OWNER: Laura
4) Workback/playbook: sheet with steps + approvals + queries + who to contact — PRACTICAL OWNER: Markus (I will own coordination)

Attachments I'll drop to this thread: service-account-inventory.csv (sanitized), scim_delta_query.sql (queries we run against SCIM logs), and a draft SA retirement playbook (sa-retirement-workback.xlsx).

Questions for you: do auditors need raw SCIM logs or are delta exports sufficient? Also, for scope — are we limited to accounts that touch MediSure production tenants only? Confirm and I'll prioritize.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Product Security
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: service-account-inventory.csv (csv), scim_delta_query.sql (sql), sa-retirement-workback.xlsx (xlsx)

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: markus.klein@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Rebecca Chen <rebecca.chen@medisure.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com, audit@sigassessments.com
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: service account retirement evidence + SCIM delta samples (SOC2)

Quick status and technical notes — I ran the extract and attached the sanitized CSV (service-account-inventory.csv). Highlights:

- 27 service accounts retired between 2025-08-01 and 2026-07-31; 19 had explicit retirement tickets, 8 were auto-rotated and flagged as orphaned.
- For SCIM deltas I used the following query (attached scim_delta_query.sql) — it pulls: event_type, timestamp, user_id, actor, source_system, delta_payload_summary.

Example output snippet (sanitized):
> user_id: sa-redwood-agg-004, event_type: DEPROVISION, timestamp: 2026-03-12T02:14:08Z, actor: svc-iam-sync, reason: "owner requested retirement", approval_ticket: RB-4521

Deliverables I will attach to the handoff folder by EOD 08/12: sanitized SCIM delta batches (zipped, three windows), the inventory CSV, and a short README with the exact queries/filters used.

Action items for Laura: can you produce the RBAC mapping doc and the brief attestation (who signed off on least-privilege checks) by 08/12 so we can include it?

Notes on retention: SCIM raw logs older than 180 days are archived; auditors sometimes request archived pulls — we can provide a digest but need explicit approval to restore full raw archives (30–48h ops window).

--
Priyom Das
Security Engineer, Platform Access
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (see previous) scim_delta_query.sql, service-account-inventory.csv

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: markus.klein@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: Rebecca Chen <rebecca.chen@medisure.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com, audit@sigassessments.com
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: service account retirement evidence + SCIM delta samples (SOC2)

Thanks team — I reviewed Priyom's inventory and added the RBAC mapping doc to the shared drive link below. New items I added:

- RBAC_mapping_onepager.pdf: maps 8 common cloud roles to Redwood permissions and highlights the least-privilege checks we run pre-retirement.
- Attestation.txt: brief signed statement confirming approvals for retirements with linked ticket IDs.

Rebecca — link to the evidence folder: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/MediSure-SOC2-evidence (I also placed a text file with the DocuSign envelope ID for the attestation). For the SCIM raw archives: we can restore a 30-day window on request; if the auditor wants full archived logs we'll need written approval from MediSure to proceed (cost/time to unarchive).

Next steps I recommend: (1) Rebecca confirms whether archived raw logs are required, (2) Redwood provides initial handoff zip with sanitized deltas + RBAC mapping + attestation (target: EOD 08/12), (3) if auditor requests archives we schedule a 1-2 day ops window and run full export.

Laura Bennett
Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
